messages:
lena_sec: Quick: planning a brief canary rebuild tonight 23:00 UTC to pick up an emergency libc patch + layer compaction. Need a KMS signer window and RBAC sanity check. Who can own key binding + log sink check?

ash_infra: Ill do the key bind and sink check. Will create a time-limited alias and grant signer role to sa-rebuild-canary for 2h.

mike_runtime: Ill run the runtime smoke and patch the GH workflow to use least-privilege role. Which KMS key/alias + image tag?

lena_sec: KMS key ring: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-main. Alias: cosign-canary-0401. Image tag: gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1740001111. Required roles: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner + roles/cloudkms.viewer (only during window).

ash_infra: Plan: grant at T-10m, revoke at T+2h. Dry-run in staging first. Command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign-canary-0401 --keyring=rebuild --location=global --member=\"serviceAccount:sa-rebuild-canary@redwood-infra\" --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner\"`

mike_runtime: Workflow change: map sa-gh-actions to sa-rebuild-canary via workload identity and use role roles/redwood.rebuildCanary for the run. Ill add cosign verify step: `cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-canary-0401 gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1740001111`

sam_oncall: Ill stand up #release-war-room and watch logs. Need someone to confirm KMS sign admin_activity/data_access and GCR push appear in logs-to-splunk-prod within 15m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build queued  repo=gcr.io/redwood/base-image tag=canary-1740001111 sha=ff12aa

ash_infra: Staging dry-run OK. Scheduling prod bind 22:50 UTC; revoke 01:00 UTC. Ill also confirm sink permissions for logs-to-splunk-prod.

mike_runtime: Running smoke script: `./scripts/smoke-canary.sh canary-1740001111` after push. Smoke covers startup, /health, and a small perf sample.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build started: tag=canary-1740001111 status=building

lena_sec: Checklist after push: 1) cosign verify OK 2) smoke script passes within threshold 3) KMS sign entries + GCR push show in sink 4) no broad roles (storage.admin/container.admin) granted to pipeline SA

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build completed: pushed & signed artifact=gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1740001111 cosign_log_id=cosign-1740001111

ash_infra: Confirmed KMS sign event and GCR push in logs-to-splunk-prod within 4m. Sink IAM looks fine. No unexpected IAM grants observed.

mike_runtime: Smoke results: startup 85ms, /health OK, basic perf within expected. cosign verify returned OK. Attaching short logs in PR.

sam_oncall: Observability good. Leaving war-room open 30m for extra watch; if nothing pops we mark canary-success and schedule rollout.

lena_sec: Thanks all. Ill post a 1-paragraph post-run in #eng-security with cosign id and auditIDs. Thread open until revoke window complete.
